# Synthetic fixture for OBS-12: zero-code auto-instrumentation with the default selection.
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: orders
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: orders
          image: example/orders:1.4.2
          command: ["opentelemetry-instrument", "python", "app.py"]
          env:
            - name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
              value: orders
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: orders
spec:
  ports:
    - port: 80
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: example/web:2.0.0
          env:
            - name: NODE_OPTIONS
              value: --require @opentelemetry/auto-instrumentations-node/register
